title: BasePass G-Buffer & Material Shader Complexity
fix_rationale: BasePass geometry and material shading are consuming excessive GPU time due to high instruction counts, texture fetches, or quad overdraw.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms ({share}% of excess time) in BasePass material shading.

fixes.text: Simplify material shader instruction counts and minimize expensive texture sample lookups.
Enable Early-Z PrePass (r.EarlyZPass 2) to eliminate masked material pixel overdraw.
Use Masked Material optimization (r.EarlyZPassMovable 1) to avoid redundant pixel shader executions.

verify: Test with simplified materials or EarlyZPass enabled and check BasePass pass times.
